_description: dns_custom Authoritative DNS Tunnel Server Configuration

_fields.mode: Operational mode: 'server' (authoritative DNS server) or 'client' (local proxy listener)
_fields.listen: UDP port to listen for incoming DNS queries (standard DNS port is :53)
_fields.target: Default backend service (tcp://127.0.0.1:22 for SSH or udp://127.0.0.1:51820 for WireGuard)
_fields.allow_targets: Patterns granting client-declared targets, e.g. ["tcp://127.0.0.1:*"]. Empty = default target only
_fields.max_sessions: Concurrent session cap (0 = unlimited). Each session holds up to ~600KB of buffers
_fields.edns0: Announce 1232-byte UDP answers via EDNS0 (set on BOTH ends or the tunnel stalls)
_fields.domain: Authoritative DNS tunnel domain delegation (e.g. t.example.com)
_fields.privkey: Noise Curve25519 static private key for end-to-end AEAD encryption (generate with 'dns_custom gen-keys')
_fields.log_level: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
